virals.name: Dan Kornas
virals.text:
Let AI propose the video cut. Keep the final say.

AI Video Editing System is a script-to-edit workflow for creators combining an Eyeline teleprompter, AI editing tools, and narration-aligned motion graphics.

It helps you move from recording to editor handoff by keeping cut proposals, design briefs, and animation timings in readable Markdown and JSON files you can review and revise.

Key features:

• Voice-following teleprompter – record microphone audio while tracking flubbed lines and multiple takes.
• Reviewable AI cuts – transcribe takes and draft a candidate cut without overwriting your working plan.
• Source-linked review – inspect waveforms and word timings, trim edges, and retain access to original source intervals.
• Narration-aligned graphics – use HTML boards and JSON timelines to time visual changes to approved audio.
• Editor handoff – organize the approved cut, audio, transcript, rendered boards, and captions for final assembly in your NLE.

This is an early public release with human review points, not a one-click unattended editor. Final assembly still happens in your editing software.

It’s open-source (MIT license).

outsiders.name: Dan Kornas
outsiders.text:
Let AI propose the video cut. Keep the final say.

AI Video Editing System is a script-to-edit workflow for creators combining an Eyeline teleprompter, AI editing tools, and narration-aligned motion graphics.

It helps you move from recording to editor handoff by keeping cut proposals, design briefs, and animation timings in readable Markdown and JSON files you can review and revise.

Key features:

• Voice-following teleprompter – record microphone audio while tracking flubbed lines and multiple takes.
• Reviewable AI cuts – transcribe takes and draft a candidate cut without overwriting your working plan.
• Source-linked review – inspect waveforms and word timings, trim edges, and retain access to original source intervals.
• Narration-aligned graphics – use HTML boards and JSON timelines to time visual changes to approved audio.
• Editor handoff – organize the approved cut, audio, transcript, rendered boards, and captions for final assembly in your NLE.

This is an early public release with human review points, not a one-click unattended editor. Final assembly still happens in your editing software.

It’s open-source (MIT license).

3. GitHub Copilot turns the recording into a list of steps you can edit.
4. One click turns it into a skill your agent can run, or an automation on a schedule.

It generalizes from one example, so recording yourself submitting one form teaches the agent to submit all of them.

Runs on Mac, Windows 11 and Ubuntu. Needs a GitHub account with Copilot access.
